definition: Extreme unwillingness to spend money or use resources.
author: Herbert George Wells
quote: But he has a reputation for wisdom and for a respectable parsimony in the village, and his knowledge of the roads of the South of England would beat Cobbett.
example_sentence: His parsimony extended to reusing teabags.
